before.name: supported-disabled-action
before.given: a state change disables a supported menu action
before.when: the user navigates with the declared per-surface policy
before.then: the action position remains stable, native AT exposes unavailable state and reason, and attempted activation dispatches no effect

before.name: all-disabled-and-focus-retirement
before.given: all menu actions are disabled or the focused action becomes disabled
before.then: the frozen policy keeps focus and dismissal reachable without invoking a disabled action or trapping focus

after.name: supported-disabled-action
after.given: a state change disables a supported menu action
after.when: the user navigates with the declared per-surface policy
after.then: the action position remains stable, native AT exposes unavailable state and any reason required by the frozen per-surface policy, and attempted activation dispatches no effect

after.name: all-disabled-and-focus-retirement
after.given: all menu actions are disabled or the focused action becomes disabled
after.then: the frozen policy keeps focus and dismissal reachable without invoking a disabled action or trapping focus

reason: Opus UX final-review objection: scenario reason availability must match frozen per-surface policy, consistent with EARS.
